description: React component for displaying a note card with timestamp, message, tags, and copy functionality, including a skeleton for loading state.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a relative time string like 'Just now', '5m ago', '2h ago', etc.

methods.name: formatFullTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a full date and time string.

methods.name: handleCopyNote
methods.description: Copies the note message, tags, and timestamp to clipboard and shows success indicator.
